no_data: No data for this period. Try a different date range.
no_data_yet: No data yet — run the first update
caption: Caption
no_ad_account: No ad account is linked to this account. Link one in Settings > Ad accounts.
competitor_note: Reach data is not available for competitors; only public follower, post and like/comment counts are shown.
tpl_monthly_hint: One or more accounts · last 30 days / last month
tpl_weekly_client_hint: One or more accounts · last 7 days
commentary_placeholder: Agency commentary, recommendations, next steps to include…
brand_hint: Your agency name, logo and colour appear in HTML/PDF reports, table PDFs, the Excel title row and the presentation cover.
logo_limit: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG · max. 1 MB (large images are downscaled)
presentation_hint: Use arrow keys · F fullscreen · Esc to exit
next_steps_placeholder: Notes shown on the last slide…
auto_sync: Auto-update once a day while the app is open
demo_banner: You are viewing demo data. Run Setup to connect your real Meta accounts.
offline: No internet connection. Existing data remains available.
sync_stale: Last update is older than 20 hours.
min_posts_note: Cells with at least {n} posts are coloured; fewer are grey.
mixed_currency_note: Selected ad accounts use different currencies; totals are mixed.
no_benchmark: At least 3 posts of this type are needed for a benchmark.
young_post: Post is {h} hours old; metrics are still growing.
no_paid: No ads are linked to this post.
not_enough_snapshots: Not enough snapshots for a lifecycle curve yet ({n}). It fills in with later updates.
no_comments: Comment sync is off or there are no comments yet.
recent_posts_hint: Posts from the last {d} days; deltas vs. the account's 90-day average for the same type.
budget_hint: Enter the monthly budget; pacing is computed over the calendar month. Nothing is changed on Meta.
boost_hint: Posts from the last 21 days on the linked Instagram profile without any ad spend yet (Reels first). Informational only.
impressions_note: Organic impressions = Instagram views; paid = Meta Ads impressions; total is their sum.
budget_tree_hint: Account budget is split evenly across campaigns, campaign budget across ad sets, ad set budget across ads. Typing an amount pins that item; the rest is shared automatically. ↺ returns to auto.
over_allocated: Manual amounts exceed the parent budget
transfer_hint: All data (accounts, posts, history, ads, settings, notes) is written to one file that another MetaDash install can import. The Meta token and App Secret are included (encrypted) only if you set a passphrase.
transfer_confirm: All current data will be replaced by the file (a copy of the previous database is saved). Continue?
no_ads_for_row: No ad data for this row
export_excel: Save the visible table as Excel
excel_hint: Excel output: summary, daily series, posts, types/hashtags, stories, demographics and ad sheets per template; the basket report lists every metric, delta, lifecycle point and ad row per post.
discovery_summary: {p} Pages, {i} Instagram accounts, {b} business portfolios scanned
discovery_warnings: Some sources could not be scanned
missing_accounts_text: The list is limited to the Pages/Instagram accounts you selected in the login window when generating the token. To add missing ones: facebook.com → Settings → Business integrations → your app → View and edit → tick the missing Pages and Instagram accounts; then generate a new token in Graph API Explorer, repeat the Token step and press "Discover again". Greyed-out accounts are usually not linked to a Page or you lack full control of that Page.
no_page_hint: Visible in Business Manager but not linked to a Facebook Page; insights need a Page link.
guide_hint: The guide covers app creation, permissions, Graph API Explorer and the misleading "needs review" notice, step by step.
about_text: Local analytics desktop app for Instagram and Meta Ads. Your data stays on this computer only.
tpl_basket_hint: Detailed analysis of the report-basket posts
basket_empty: The report basket is empty. Add posts from Content or Compare.
basket_usage: Basket posts can be a section in client reports, a standalone "Selected posts report", or a presentation slide.
reach_vs_avg_hint: Reach and difference vs. account average
health_formula: growth 30% + engagement 30% + consistency 20% + response 20% (half answered rate, half answered within the reply target, 24 h by default); percentile among accounts on the same platform
lifecycle_hint: Post age (hours) → share of final reach. Derived from snapshots.
story_hint: Story data is collected within 24 hours; refreshed every 4 hours while the app is open.
demographics_hint: Demographics are refreshed once a week.
per_post_avg_note: Averages per post in the selected period.
restore_confirm: Replace the current database with the selected backup?
auto_update_check: Check for updates automatically (GitHub, every 6 hours)
upd_dev: Update checks are disabled in development builds
notify_hint: Desktop notifications are evaluated after every sync and once a day; the same alert is not repeated. No notifications are sent in demo mode.
notify_budget: Ad account reaches 90% of its monthly budget
welcome_intro: MetaDash shows the organic performance of all the Instagram business accounts you manage and their linked Meta ad accounts in one place.
welcome_time: You will create a Meta app, obtain a token and pick the accounts to track.
welcome_local: Everything is stored in a local SQLite database; nothing is sent to the cloud.
welcome_nosub: You use your own Meta app and your own API token.
welcome_connect_desc: Connect your Instagram and ad accounts with your own Meta app (about 15 minutes).
welcome_demo_desc: Try every screen right away with 40 fictional accounts. Switch to a real setup later via Settings > Delete all data.
welcome_prereq: Prerequisites: each Instagram account must be a Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook Page, and your Meta user must be an admin of those Pages.
app_step_1: Open developers.facebook.com → My Apps → Create App.
app_step_2: Choose "Other" → "Business" as the app type and give it any name.
app_step_3: From the dashboard add the products "Instagram Graph API" and "Marketing API".
app_step_4: Leave the app in Development mode. No App Review is needed because you only access assets you manage.
app_step_5: Settings → Basic: copy App ID and App Secret and paste them below.
app_secret_note: The secret is stored in the local database, encrypted (AES-256-GCM) with a key tied to this computer, and never leaves it.
token_step_1: Open Graph API Explorer and select your app in the top-right "Meta App" dropdown.
token_step_2: Under "Permissions" add all of the scopes below, then click "Generate Access Token" and approve the pages/Instagram accounts.
token_step_3: In the login window choose ALL Pages, Instagram accounts and ad accounts. A notice saying the app "needs review before going live" is informational in Development mode: click Continue, do not submit for review.
token_step_4: Copy the short-lived token and paste it below. MetaDash exchanges it for a 60-day long-lived token and verifies it.
missing_scopes: Missing: {s}. Add them in Graph API Explorer under Permissions and generate a new token.
accounts_intro: All Instagram business accounts reachable with your token. Select the ones to track, optionally set a client name and tags.
page_without_ig: This Page has no linked Instagram business account. Link one in Instagram → Settings → Account type & tools.
ad_accounts_intro: Ad accounts found with your token. Link each to an Instagram account to see organic + paid together. This step is optional.
first_sync_intro: The first sync fetches the last 12 months of posts, their insights, daily account insights and ad performance. It can take a few minutes for 40 accounts.
demo_prompt: Want to explore first? Load a demo dataset of 40 accounts.
ai_intro: Optional: bring your own API key to draft report commentary and explain anomalies.
ai_privacy: When you use an AI feature, a summary of the relevant analytics (account names, metrics, post captions) is sent to the selected provider. Nothing is sent otherwise. Use Ollama to keep everything on this computer.
ai_replace_confirm: Replace the current commentary with the AI draft?
ai_draft_note: AI draft — review it before exporting.
ai_truncated: The answer may be cut off.
ai_disclaimer: Generated by AI from your data; treat it as a hypothesis, not a conclusion.
ask_intro: Ask questions about your accounts, content and ads in plain language. Answers come from read-only queries on your local database.
ask_off_title: The AI assistant is turned off
ask_off_hint: To use "Ask your data", choose a provider and enable it in Settings → AI assistant. When you ask, your question and the query results are sent to that provider; Meta tokens and settings are never sent.
ask_placeholder: Ask a question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
ask_s_growth: Which 5 accounts grew fastest in the last 30 days?
ask_s_type: Which content type gets the best engagement for @{u}?
ask_s_type_all: Which content type gets the best engagement?
ask_s_spend: How much did we spend on ads this month per client?
ask_s_reach: Which 5 posts had the highest reach in the selected period?
ask_no_queries: No queries were run for this answer.
ask_disclaimer: AI answer — check the queries before relying on it.
viewers_tip: On Facebook, reach is the number of unique people who saw your content at least once (Meta calls it "Viewers").
views_as_primary_tip: Threads has no reach metric; views are shown here instead.
follower_overlap_note: Followers are summed across platforms; the same person may follow you on more than one.
mixed_platforms_note: You are comparing accounts from different platforms. Metric definitions differ (Facebook reach = viewers; Threads uses views instead of reach), so read differences with care.
save_rate_na_some: At least one selected account has no save rate.
section_na: Not available for the selected accounts
demographics_threads_hint: Threads demographics need at least 100 followers and refresh weekly.
read_insights_note: read_insights is optional and only needed for Facebook Page insights.
fb_pages_intro: Tick the Pages whose own metrics (viewers, views, post engagements) you want to track. Off by default and counted separately from Instagram accounts.
fb_no_analyze: You lack the ANALYZE task on this Page, so its insights cannot be read.
fb_missing_scopes: Missing permissions: {s}. Renew the token with them (Setup → step 3).
not_in_build: Not available in this build yet.
threads_intro: Connect your Threads profile to add views, likes, replies, reposts and followers. This step is optional: skip it and connect later from Settings → Connections.
threads_app_hint: Add the "Access the Threads API" use case to your Meta app. The Threads app ID and secret are different from the Meta app ID.
threads_request_publish: Also request publishing permission (for the Planner; the Threads use case needs threads_content_publish)
threads_access_hint: Paste a short-lived token from the Threads user token generator in the App Dashboard, or open the authorization page and paste the "code" value from the redirect URL.
threads_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect Threads? Existing data is kept.
threads_auto_refresh: The token is refreshed automatically before it expires.
connections_hint: Instagram and Facebook share the Meta token; Threads is a separate connection.
lang_partial_tip: Partly translated: untranslated text is shown in English.
